items.title: Bob Magnusson interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: My wife Janet and I had our son at that time.

ctx.x: She was a wonderful boss. You know she had the nickname “Sassy” and she could be, and I saw her do it in the three years that I worked for her. But never, ever with any of us musicians. With club owners that would try to give her a hard time, or management, that kind of thing. I would see her go off on them. But she loved the musicians. And she did some absolutely wonderful things. My wife Janet and I had our son at that time. We have a son and three daughters, and at the time we just had our — and we were in New…
get my groove with him, it’ll be in the right place. And he was just a sweetheart to me. I mean he is just a lovely, lovely man. I love him dearly to this day.
